deadline.value: Central scholarship rounds (RTP, University Research Scholarship): the international Round 1 deadline (Aug 31) for 2027 starts by end of March already closed on Aug 31, 2026. The next round is Round 2, closing Apr 15, 2027 (year inferred), for starts by Aug 31, 2027; RTP describes it as typically a smaller round. Admission applications are open all year.
deadline.quote: The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.

supervisor.value: Admission requires written approval from an identified supervisor. Email potential supervisors first, or submit an expression of interest if unsure.
supervisor.quote: Have the written approval of an identified supervisor for the research project/thesis.

also.quote: Once an academic supervisor has been confirmed to support your application you may proceed to step three. | If you are not sure which area of research or supervisor matches your interest please complete an expression of interest and we will get in contact with you.

funding.value: Scholarships are highly competitive and an offer of admission does not guarantee one. First-class honours may generally be needed for scholarship consideration. The RTP stipend is AUD 40,475 per year (2027 base rate); international HDR students can also get the RTP Fee Offset Scholarship alongside the stipend. International tuition is AUD 57,640 a year (indicative).

entry_route.value: A relevant bachelor's honours degree with at least Second Class Honours, Upper (H2A), or the international equivalent, or another degree with a significant research or thesis component. No rule on 3-year vs 4-year Indian degrees is stated.

notes: Four-year full-time PhD (academic plan 9680XPHD). Scholarship applicants are considered automatically through the admission application; the application and referee reports must be complete by the round deadline, so submit 2–3 weeks early. Admission is also subject to supervisory capacity.
